_comment: Draft narration for the current synthetic coordinator flows. Capture actual product only after exact-release acceptance; captions do not establish deployment. Merismos video schema and ElevenLabs provider contract.
_comment_length: Target 90–174 seconds, seven beats of 3–40 seconds. Draft timing only; measured audio/video and captions must pass the project gates before publication.

segments.captionText: A community-food coordinator needs more than a split. They need to know why one organisation receives food, why another cannot, and who will collect it. Merismos demonstrates that workflow with five invented organisations and synthetic donations. No real delivery or impact is claimed.

segments.captionText: Open the Merismos coordinator workspace with no account. On the Dashboard, choose + Add offer, then Try success. The fields remain editable. Choose Add to sandbox, and the invented donation opens on Decide. This uses a real HTTP API, a saved sandbox session and a real Strands agent loop, not a prerecorded answer.

segments.captionText: The coordinator chooses Work out the split. Separate scheduled deferrals can append an escalation, not approve a publication. There is no automatic chat intake or message delivery. The public sandbox uses a scripted model with no model network call. Live records are separately read-only.

segments.captionText: Try refusal fills in a broken cold chain: after Add to sandbox and Work out the split, the result offers no approval. Try correction fills in an invented phone-shaped note: intake is refused and the fields remain available to correct. On a passing plan, read the exact record text and address, tick the consent box and choose Approve in sandbox. On Pickups, collection needs a claim and a separate explicit confirmation.

segments.captionText: Strands runs each specialist's agent loop and dispatches its tool calls. A Merismos guard on the SDK's BeforeToolCallEvent hook cancels forbidden calls before they run. CI tests remove that guard and then remove the SDK to demonstrate both boundaries. A separate deterministic gate checks the draft. Live runs use Bedrock Opus 5. A public request cannot start one, and each deploy apply fails unless its proof run records a specialist answer from the model.

segments.captionText: The evidence bundle keeps public sources, decision reasons, run and workspace revision, provider, mode, record history and handoff together. Hashes bind bytes, not source truth or delivery. Live recovery requires an authenticated coordinator and checks one reserved attempt without publishing again. Historical records are not silently repaired.

segments.captionText: Merismos keeps an allocation decision beside its collection handoff. Copy the evidence for your own review; nothing is sent automatically. Human active time, savings and food rescued remain unmeasured. Open the sandbox and try the three editable flows. CI and the deployed release run automated checks; human acceptance testing has not been done.
